gates.G1_runner: Rows 1 and 8 are my own example.com brackets. If either is not ok/200, or the relay's own control row is not ok, or void is true, the batch is VOID as to every content row.

gates.G5_status_is_not_source_state: CARDINAL. A refused/403, a 404, or a find_matched:false is a statement about this client's access at that instant, or about a string in one rendering at that instant. NONE may be restated as a fact about a case, an award, a proceeding, a treaty, or a document's existence. In particular: nothing in this batch may found a claim that A/81/17 has or has not been issued, that the Einarsson award has or has not issued, or that the China-Switzerland BIT does or does not contain a denial-of-benefits clause.
gates.G6_rendered_text_only: The relay strips every tag AND attribute (scripts/fetch_relay.py:126-128). A string present only in an href or an attribute is INVISIBLE to this channel. Every find_matched:false below carries this limit.
gates.G7_entity_blind: Per 0806-O6 (standing): the find is a literal case-insensitive substring test. A symbol rendered with an HTML entity or a non-ASCII solidus reads as absent.

decision_rules.E1: UNIT: rows 2 and 3 (ICSID UNCT/20/6 docket, finds 'Procedural Orders' and 'Published Decisions'). These are the companion rows next step 1 authorised. The route was ESTABLISHED on 2026-08-13 (ok/200, 'Latest Development' and 'Status of Proceeding' both matched on this exact URL), so no fresh identity row is needed and none is fired — and per 0813-B5 a BARE row on icsid.worldbank.org discriminates nothing anyway, because an empty find returns body[:400] which on this host is global navigation by construction. If a find matches, ONLY the returned 400-character window may be read. A window is not a docket. If a find MISSES, the recorded fact is that the string was absent from that rendering at that instant — most likely the field is not rendered on this case page — and per G5 that is NOT a finding that no procedural orders or published decisions exist in the proceeding.

decision_rules.E3: UNIT: row 6 (same page, find 'fifty-ninth'). This is next step 6 and it is INSTRUMENT-SCOPED. On 2026-08-13 this URL returned its long-stable byte length (832,338) with a DIFFERENT sha256 than the fifteen prior rows at nine dates. This row asks an anchored question of the 59th-session block. WHAT IT MAY FOUND: what that block's rendered text says at this instant. WHAT IT MAY NOT FOUND: that anything CHANGED.
